subject: Science
note: Starter syllabus based on the rationalised NCERT Class 10 Science textbook. To be checked against the official CBSE 2026-27 curriculum by agents/syllabus_agent.md before it is treated as final.

chapters.name: Life Processes
topics: What are life processes
Nutrition: autotrophic nutrition (photosynthesis)
Nutrition: heterotrophic nutrition and how organisms obtain food
Nutrition in human beings
Respiration: aerobic and anaerobic, human respiratory system
Transportation in human beings: heart, blood vessels, blood, lymph
Transportation in plants: water and food
Excretion in human beings and in plants

chapters.name: Control and Coordination
topics: Animals: nervous system, neurons, synapse
Reflex action and reflex arc
Human brain and its parts
How nervous tissue causes action
Coordination in plants: immediate response to stimulus
Coordination in plants: movement due to growth (tropisms), plant hormones
Hormones in animals: endocrine glands and feedback mechanism

chapters.name: How do Organisms Reproduce?
topics: Do organisms create exact copies of themselves? DNA copying and variation
Modes of reproduction used by single organisms: fission, fragmentation, regeneration, budding, vegetative propagation, spore formation
Sexual reproduction: why the sexual mode
Sexual reproduction in flowering plants
Reproduction in human beings: changes at puberty, male and female reproductive systems
What happens when the egg is not fertilised
Reproductive health

chapters.name: Heredity
topics: Accumulation of variation during reproduction
Inherited traits
Rules for the inheritance of traits: Mendel's contributions (monohybrid and dihybrid crosses)
How do these traits get expressed
Sex determination

chapters.name: Our Environment
topics: Ecosystem and its components
Food chains and webs, trophic levels, 10 percent law
Biological magnification
How do our activities affect the environment: ozone layer depletion
Managing the garbage we produce
